claims.claim: Drivers of vehicles that do not meet emissions standards may have to pay to enter a Clean Air Zone.
claims.quote: You might need to pay to drive in a clean air zone if your vehicle does not meet emissions standards.
claims.note: The source expressly ties possible charges to a vehicle not meeting emissions standards.

claims.claim: The typical emissions thresholds are Euro 6 for diesel vehicles and Euro 4 for petrol vehicles.
claims.quote: Cars, taxis and private hire M1 Passenger vehicle with up to 8 seats in addition to the driver Euro 6 (diesel). Euro 4 (petrol)
claims.note: The annex lists these standards for cars, taxis and private hire vehicles; coverage varies by zone class and vehicle type.

claims.claim: Clean Air Zones include Bath, Birmingham, Bradford and Portsmouth.
claims.quote: Bath Birmingham Bradford Bristol Portsmouth Sheffield Tyneside - Newcastle and Gateshead
claims.note: All four named places appear in the list of zones covered by the service.

claims.claim: Charges vary by zone and vehicle type.
claims.quote: Matters to be dealt with in charging schemes by charging authorities include: designating the roads and classes of vehicles subject to a charge the charges imposed
claims.note: The framework makes vehicle classes and charges matters for each scheme, but the excerpt does not explicitly say charge amounts differ across zones or vehicle types.
